item.title: 1.1.109b1 (Beta)
item.description:
Notes ++ 1.1.109b1 — Beta: Anki connection recovery

- A deck with unavailable counts no longer disconnects the entire Anki dashboard. Available counts still load, and incomplete totals are clearly labeled.
- Avoids repeatedly reinstalling an already-current Notes ++ Filtered Decks helper. Provides restart and enablement instructions, with subdecks as an interim alternative.

Four recovery tests passed. The affected user's helper-loading compatibility still needs verification with their Anki version.

To receive this beta, enable Settings → Updates → Receive beta updates, then check for updates.

Notes ++ 1.1.107 — A board for your class

- Separate MS1 and MS2 class boards follow the medical year selected in Settings. Each class has its own publishing permissions and local cache. Existing exam breakdowns stay on the MS2 board.
- A searchable split-view lecture picker makes choosing a second lecture easier.
- Anki requests allow more time for large collections and explain connection problems more clearly.
- Class enrollment supports up to three signed-in devices per person.

Notes ++ 1.1.106 — A board for your class

- Separate MS1 and MS2 class boards follow the medical year selected in Settings. Each class has its own publishing permissions and local cache. Existing exam breakdowns stay on the MS2 board.
- A searchable split-view lecture picker makes choosing a second lecture easier.
- Anki requests allow more time for large collections and explain connection problems more clearly.
- Class enrollment supports up to three signed-in devices per person.

Notes ++ 1.1.103 — A clearer, more flexible LO reader

- Search AI LO answers with exact-word highlights and match indicators on the LO buttons.
- Command-click Read to detach answers into a separate window above Notes ++. The reader hides when switching to another app.
- More compact arrow-connected figures preserve branches, shared steps and relationship labels. Existing answers use the improved layout automatically.
- Cleaner answer headings and metadata, corrected italic formatting around linked terms, and better drawer sizing in smaller windows.
- Keep the AI answer drawer open when changing lectures and preserve its position when reopening it.
- Split lectures now show highlights, drawings and notes, support editing, and route search and undo to the active pane.
- Press H with PDF text selected to apply a text highlight.

Notes ++ 1.1.102 — PDF scrolling stability

- Fixes the note layout path implicated in a PDF scrolling crash on macOS 27. Manually positioned note controls no longer enter an unconstrained Auto Layout pass, and inner scroll-view geometry updates wait until the current layout pass finishes.
- Fitting notes no longer resize an unused hidden scroll view. Long notes still scroll internally, and editing focus is preserved when a note grows into scrolling mode.
- Validated with 49 targeted checks covering a SwiftUI-hosted PDF canvas, repeated scrolling and resizing, extreme zoom, typing, tables, and note visibility. Confirmation on the affected macOS 27 device is still pending.

item.title: 1.1.97b1 (Beta)
item.description:
Notes ++ 1.1.97b1 — Beta: scrolling crash fix

- Defers and combines note refreshes and page updates so they run after AppKit scroll callbacks.
- Disables concurrent scrolling for the custom note canvas and note scroll views to avoid overlapping text geometry and window constraint updates.
- Avoids redundant note text-frame changes.
- Defers current-LO tracking and scroll-triggered AMBOSS dismissal.

Testing: 31 regression checks passed, including repeatedly editing a note and scrolling away and back, zoom, note scroll handoff, LO navigation, and hover behavior. The exact crash reported on macOS 26.6.2 still needs verification by the affected tester.

Testers: enable Settings → Updates → Receive beta updates, then check for updates. Stable users remain on 1.1.96.

Notes ++ 1.1.94 — Objectives that stay with your lectures

- Learning objectives retain a persistent file association through folder moves and renames, including collision suffixes. Existing stale download paths recover when the match is unambiguous. AI LO Answers uses the same association.
- Well matched in the AnKing panel now selects individual cards with stronger relevance evidence rather than all cards in a matching topic.
- Create a named filtered deck automatically from selected cards. First use installs the bundled Notes ++ Anki helper and requires one Anki restart; subsequent creations finish directly from Notes ++. Existing deck names are protected, and deleting a filtered deck returns cards to their original decks.
- Optional Remember lecture slide positions setting under Settings → Drawing restores the saved slide position across app restarts. The default keeps the existing brief-switching behavior.

Validation: 83 objective/parser/group tests, 64 AnKing/scroll-position tests, and four filtered-deck tests using a temporary Anki collection passed.

Notes ++ 1.1.86 — Clearer answers and easier lecture updates

- Read LO answers continuously with working objective navigation, automatic current-LO highlighting (including the final objective), text-size controls, reading mode and per-LO copying. Removed the bouncing animation and “Jump to” label.
- More compact pathway diagrams, improved table sizing and the original brighter table headers.
- Select individual lectures to download. Command-click Download to fetch updated slides and replace matching existing files in their current group folders. Ambiguous duplicate filenames are reported instead of overwritten arbitrarily.
- Add comments to selected PDF text or existing text highlights through the right-click menu. Hover to read comments; edits support undo/redo.
- Removed text-box glow and added layout changes targeting folder-import hangs and note-creation constraint crashes.

Notes ++ 1.1.85 — Natural zoom and better drawing

- Pinch zoom stays on the visible slide. Wide side notes no longer allow zoom to crop a slide that still fits in the window; manual scrolling can still reach the notes canvas.
- Hold Shift while dragging, or draw and hold still for half a second, to straighten pen, highlighter and arrow strokes. Straight lines gently snap horizontally near 0°/180°.
- Click the active eraser again to choose its size and whole/partial-stroke mode. The size persists, controls the erase area, and is reflected in the quickly fading trail.
- The university model picker continues to offer Claude Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 only.

Notes ++ 1.1.83 — Try GPT and type more smoothly

- Choose GPT-5.6 Sol alongside Claude in Settings → Free Claude credits.
- GPT learning-objective answers and quizzes stay private to the user's Mac. They never read from or write to either class bank, while generation remains metered against the user's university allowance.
- Side-note typing is smoother. Notes no longer reapply unchanged paragraph formatting or force redundant layout and redraw passes on every keystroke.
- Note zoom scaling, text wrapping, automatic growth and saving continue to work normally.

- Undo and redo now include new text boxes, note edits, moves and drawing actions in a shared chronological history. Scrolling and automatic layout do not add undo steps.
- Undo/redo buttons show a subtle hover highlight. Activate the eraser with one click; click it again to choose whole or partial erasing.
- Partial erasing preserves the untouched portions of text highlights, including other highlighted lines.
- Tags use tag-shaped icons to distinguish them from folder colors, and lazy tag menus can populate on the first attempt.
- Pinch and Command-scroll zoom keep the gesture point steady on both axes instead of drifting toward the notes area. Keyboard zoom centers on the visible slide.

Notes ++ 1.1.81 — Smoother notes and focused practice

- Choose Claude Sonnet 5 or Opus 5 for university AI. Older saved model preferences migrate automatically. The class answer bank prefers Claude 5 answers while older app versions can still generate answers.
- Practice Weak Objectives builds a separate follow-up quiz from objectives missed in newly generated quizzes, preserving the original quiz and its results.
- Smoother free-draw arrows and a quickly fading, tapered eraser trail. Choose partial-stroke or whole-stroke erasing; the selected mode persists.
- Side notes scale with slides without changing text wrapping. Fixed screen-size notes remain an option in Settings → Drawing. Fixes disappearing text after zooming and scrolling and separates the note move and connector handles.
- Pasted text adopts the note's formatting.
- A Drawing settings tab includes an Apple Pencil / Sidecar option to hide drawing cursors. Search Settings to find options faster; university Claude enrollment is easier to find.
- Reader action buttons stay on the right in narrower windows.
- Opt into future beta releases from Settings → Updates. Stable updates remain available to everyone.
